etymologies.etymologyHTML: Borrowed from French ambulance, which replaced hôpital ambulant (“moving hospital”) via the suffix -ance, from Latin ambulō (“to walk; to go about”).

definitions.definition: An emergency vehicle designed for transporting seriously ill or injured people to a hospital. [1854[1]]
(UK) A vehicle used for the transportation of dead people, typically to a mortuary.
(chiefly UK, obsolete) Synonym of stretcher, a litter used for medical transport.

quote.citation: 1918, Western Surgical Association: Transactions, volume 27, page 66:
quote.text: Ambulancing patients with acute obstruction over cobble and rails should not be tolerated; better render the necessary service where the patient is found.

pronunciation: African-American Vernacular, also Southern American English
